body:
Releasing the claim on the agent-browser hang. Product commit 3d6c1e6.

What was wrong. `AgentBrowser._run` ran the CLI with `subprocess.run(capture_output=True, timeout=...)`.
agent-browser keeps a daemon owning the browser between invocations, that daemon inherits the handles it is
handed, and on Windows it does not let go of them. A pipe reaches end-of-file only when every writer closes
it, so the read waited on a process that had already answered; and on timeout `run` kills the command and
then reads the very pipe the daemon still holds, so the wait was unbounded rather than timed.

What shipped. `_run_cli()` is now the single place that runs the CLI: it resolves the name through PATH
(CreateProcess does not read PATHEXT the way a shell does) and captures into files rather than pipes. `_run`
keeps its shape and goes through it. The read-surface sweep test uses the same helper rather than its own
subprocess call, so it cannot drift from how the adapter really runs the tool.

Verified (all on the Windows desktop, the machine the bug reproduced on):
- `tests/test_agent_browser.py`: 16 of 17 pass, including `test_the_real_cli_reads_a_real_page`, which now
  opens a real page against real headless Chrome and reads its accessibility tree. It previously never
  returned.
- Full engine suite: `pytest tests -q` -> 294 passed, 1 failed, in 76s. It previously never finished; the run
  had to be killed twice after 30+ minutes.
- `pytest server/tests -q` -> 38 passed. `npm --prefix app run build` -> green. `ledger-gates pre-commit` ->
  PASSED.
- The environment needed `aiohttp` and `ti-matrix-server`, which this machine's uv venv did not have; that is
  installed now and recorded in `memory/system/environments.md`.

Not done, and deliberately not claimed as done. The one remaining failure is not this claim's: the table
declares four experimental `webmcp_*` actions that the installed CLI 0.35.1 does not implement. Raised as
correction 20260926T071641Z-Ines-ccfac202 and queued as B-2026-09-26-1, with the three candidate repairs and
the reason each was left to the user -- chiefly that upgrading the global CLI has a blast radius beyond this
session, since other tooling on this machine drives the same binary.

Files touched: ti_matrix/adapters/browser/agent_browser.py, tests/test_agent_browser.py. Safe to touch both now.
